description: Component technical parameters for the CICT-J526A-STS family (U1-C68): supplementary to documents/prompt-pack/reference/major-parameters.json and imported with it by import-parameters (DATA_CONTRACT s3.8, s8). Observations are source facts with document, PDF page and locator; values describe the drawing family, not one crane. Differing observations are unresolved conflicts until Admin records a value with a reason.
